download_chameleon_data: download the Chameleon repository and prompts data from GitHub to a local data directory
load_chameleon_prompts: load Chameleon prompts from the JSONL file and download associated images into a local directory
download_image_from_url: download an image from a given URL with retry logic and save it to a specified path
generate_image_filename: generate a unique sanitized filename for an image based on its URL, category, and sample ID
create_lookup_key: create a composite lookup key string from a prompt ID and category for dictionary indexing
